review_description: Mondiaux were a great company to deal with from the get go. They provided us with a variety of options for our house and explained everything clearly. Customer service was helpful and informative throughout the process. The installers were prompt, polite and professional. Would highly recommend.

Mondiaux were the most professional and responsive of all the installers I met with and dealt with. Brian from their sales team is a consummate professional, and I never felt under any pressure to buy. He spent a lot of time working through my needs and wants and gave absolutely appropriate advice at all times.  I would be happy to recommend them to anyone.

I am extremely delighted to recommend MONDIAUX SOLAR as the supplier / installer for your new solar system. They not only provided me with the most competitive quote, more importantly they pay great attention to customer experience. Out of several solar quotes that I received, MONDIAUX SOLAR was the only supplier sent out solar consultant for pre-quote site inspection, answered all my queries and showed a genuine interest in securing my businessBrian from MONDIAUX SOLAR, his services was exceptional and attentive. The AIKO ABC all black Solar panels that Brian recommended are so visually appealing. They are highly efficient panels with shade optimisation built in. That means there is no need to add and pay extra costs for solar optimisers. I am very happy with MONDIAUX SOLAR, and the solar system they supplied.

Technical difficulties resulted in Mondiaux receiving the request for quote late in the peace but certainly had the best solution, price and panel configuration on the roof.  Installation and follow-up support all occurred as promised. 6.6 KW installation started at 8am and completed  by midday without any issues.

Quoting process was excellent with no pressure  to adopt larger system beyond needs.Had to wait a couple of months for installation but was installed in about 3 hours once started.Installers altered panel layout on the day to maximise sunlight interception.Installers were polite and answered questions I had about the system.Installers also set up wifi connection for iSolarCloud monitoring software which is excellent for monitoring performance.The system is meeting production estimates provided in the quote. I export between 75 and 90% of system output and I have a net credit for the year compared to a $1200 bill previously.The Sungrow inverter was placed inside the garage to avoid the sun but it makes a loud high pitched noise when operating at capacity which is annoying and I would have had it placed outside with a cover had I been aware of that. I have added an external cooling fan to reduce the heat load and the inverter noise.Overall I am very happy with the system.

Could not be more impressed with the attitude, attention to detail and  time spent with me explaining the systems, how they worked and the whole process. Geoffrey Shinozaki-Langridge is brilliant and did not at any stage make me feel that he was just selling a system.  He took the time to explain everything and could not have been more helpful.
Very happy with the solar system installed by Mondiaux Solar. They are professional and thoughtful. I would definitely recommend Mondiaux to whoever I knew was looking for solar panels.

Mondiaux Solar installed my solar two years ago and they regularly maintained excellent communication to address any concerns and provide effective solutions. I highly recommend their top-notch service to anyone.
Good customer service, helpful and friendly people, neat and efficient installation, good communication

Great install, polite, tidy , punctual and efficient.The installer made an adjustment to the proposed layout on the install day, improvement on solar yield, he could have just installed as drawn but but some effort and thought into the install.not so great communication overall from the office side of things, I had to ring them for any info, could be much better in this regard.awaiting new meter to finalise but they said its organised, no reason not to believe this.

Easy process of getting the quotes for our solar system, but we chose the best value for roughly the same price, newest technology offered as well. Installation was done surprisingly quick (about 6 hours for 11kW/23 panels), all taken care including organising every detail about our connection to the grid, replacing the antique energy meter and making sure we got everything we need in order to enjoy the free energy.

I just thought it important to share that Mondiaux after installation service was excellent - they are prompt, professional and spend time in providing details on what was causing the problem.I was very happy with the installation and the service levels have continued even after the sale.Great work Mondiaux!

I was happy initially, Garry made an on site inspection and gave a neat solution at a reasonable price. So far so good. The installation date was a little later than I hoped as this was a time sensitive project. On the date no one had arrived at well past the notified time so I had to ring up and chase them. At 2.30pm one north Asian person arrived, unable to speak English but clearly unhappy about the meter box of which photos had been supplied.Another two members of the installation team arrived about five minutes later, one of whom did speak English. While he was trying to resolve the situation of space on the meter box for what I was led to believe was a monitor for the system the other team member was on the roof.Although a sight inspection was part of the proposal they did not have the correct brackets for flat terracotta tiles and left after twenty minutes saying they would order the correct brackets.The following week I was told that the installation team refused to complete the installation. After another week I was told that Mondiaux could not find an installer to complete the project.I therefore cancelled the contract after two months, achieving nothing.The only good news is that my deposit was returned. Until they can find reliable and capable installers I cannot recommend them as suppliers

Archie, Jonathan, Sam and the rest of the install team worked hard together to achieve the system that we hoped to install - one that used quality components and which maximised the roof space on our relatively small but optimally North-aligned home.Archie was a knowledgeable friendly and helpful salesperson. To achieve the most out of our smallish roof space, he recommended higher capacity PV panels. Ultimately we filled our north facing roof with 11.4kW of solar power collecting potential. This combined with a quality inverter meant we have a good amount of PV headroom and an ability to overcome short losses of mains power (rare as they are here in Canberra).We are delighted with our system and highly appreciative of the service we received from Mondiaux Solar.

My 8.56 kW three-phase set-up with a SolarEdge SE8.25K three-phase hybrid inverter, 22 Jinko Tiger KM390N-6RL3-B panels with optimisers and consumption monitoring has been in operation for just over a year.Of the three quotes I received from the installers recommended by SolarQuotes, I ended up selecting the one from Solar Family. However, between getting the quote (for a single-phase system), making some tweaks and making a decision to go ahead, the company disappeared - they didn't answer my calls and the website vanished. Close call!So, after checking reviews for other installers on SolarQuotes, I ended up going with Mondiaux Solar. I was pleased with the level of support provided through the process of quoting and adjusting the design to accommodate available roof space and an existing thermal pool heating system. Mondiaux were also on top of the benefits of a three-phase system.Despite being assured several times that Mondiaux's own staff would do the installation, on the day it turned out that CRE Electrical was subcontracted to do the installation! CRE Electrical had very few reviews on SolarQuotes at the time, but fortunately they were efficient, friendly and patiently addressed my questions. The did turn up an hour early on installation day, so had to wait for me to get home before they could start.After installation, one of the optimisers was dead and it took 2 months to have it replaced. I don't blame the installers for that - it just took ages to get the replacement from SolarEdge.Four of the panels were installed in landscape orientation and clamped on the short edge. After reading articles on SolarQuotes warning about potential issues with clamping larger-sized 390W panels on the short edges, before making final payment I sought assurance in writing from CRE and Mondiaux that the short-edge clamping wouldn't void the panel warranties. Verbal assurance was readily provided, but it took a lot of pushing over 3 months to get something in writing. Hopefully the official-looking certificate that they provided from Jinko will suffice if there are ever any issues!A year on, everything is running well, the system is generating about as was promised and there have been no issues to date - other than the shading issues that Mondiaux rightfully pointed out early on (but the panel-level monitoring certainly helps make clear how much I still need to lop off the troublesome trees!). Despite paying a bit more to set myself up with a three-phase hybrid inverter for a home battery at some point in the future, I am still undecided whether to get one. I am somewhat sceptical of their reliability and since my new Nissan LEAF with its V2X functionality arrived recently, I am now eagerly monitoring developments in vehicle-to-grid capability...

I am very happy with my Mondiaux sales and installation, and with the Alpha Ess inverter and batter so far.I found the process of understanding all the options and possibilities and choosing a system quite a big job. Having backup power was important to me, so I wanted a system with a battery. The Mondiaux salesperson spent time answering all of my questions and put together a quote and package that contained everything I wanted at a reasonable price.The process was held up by covid shutdowns and the impact on workforce, unsurprisingly, but once it was booked in, the installation team worked very hard to put the system in and did a good job. The follow-up service to commission the system and make sure everything was right was very good.The main problems I had were that the backup circuit was not completed at the time of the installation. I followed up with the sales person and the staff member who came to commission the system, and the backup circuit was installed about a fortnight later. It would have been good to have some clearer advice about the load the backup circuits could take, and what that would mean for my decision about where I wanted the backup. While I knew what my priorities were (fridge and internet), I hadn't known all of the factors involved, and would have made a different choice with better information.There was a faulty LED on the battery display, which the staff member identified and arranged to have replaced. So while the process took a bit longer and wasn't as smooth as it could have been, the company did respond to my follow-up queries and now everything is complete and working well. Very satsifying.
Every thing was excellent Mondiaux Pty Ltd  are a high quality provider

The initial design and quoting process was really well managed and questions were very quickly and comprehensively addressed. Also fine tuning of the proposal was quickly incorporated ready for the next phase of our process. Especially given the flash lockdown due COVID outbreak right in the middle!We wanted to take advantage of the ACT Governments new interest free Green Load opportunity, which Mondiaux helped as much as they could, unfortunately the application and approval really slow progress due to external factors (Christmas break, COVID lock-downs and the high number of applications) and the program has only just opened so was a rough and ready to start with... Not in any way a Mondiaux issue and they tried really hard to help, where they could.Once approved, Mondiaux locked in the installation within days and were happy to change dates due to our scheduling conflict.Installation was done really quickly and professionally, the team was really friendly and careful. Our roof is 50 years old and they only had 3 tile breakages and nothing else was scratched, broken or messed with! Really pleased.All the STS and Doco was done quickly and accurately and the the grid connection/meter change was very quickly organised. The set up of the monitoring/management software was done a week after the installation.We are exceptionally pleased with how everything has worked out except one point:As we had been in lockdown, none-one had actually been onsite to make sure battery location, panel location and roof condition and trees etc were all OK before we starting installing. Once lockdown was lifted, I requested Mondiaux do a site check before installation.Unfortunately the site check was promised multiple times but never happened. The installation team and I then had to sort out a few things that could easily have been avoided or done differently. They were very supportive and prepared to make adjustments "on the go'' but it could have easily gone very badly!
The company appears to be very professional and focused. the sales rep was very knowledgeable about their product.

Reaching an agreed qoute took a bit of time due to modification upgrades I wanted. Solar panel installation went well and is working I guess the best it can due to the inclement weather. The company arranged grid connection.

We were very impressed by Mondiaux at the quotation and advice stage. Prices quoted for different systems were competitive and technical advice was comprehensive.Installation was prompt and tidy, and the technicians polite and informative.Commissioning of the system 4 days after installation (very timely) appeared on track until a loose wire was discovered in the control panel installed by Mondiaux.  This was rectified immediately.We were also informed not to use the system until ACTEWAGL had approved the installation and all safety regulations had been met, including the installation of a new meter.  Not sure why a new meter could not have been ordered when we placed an order for the solar system, rather than at the end of the process.Technical advice on how to manage and monitor the system remotely was available, but minimal and not easy to follow.Overall, I was happy with Mondiaux, but know more NOW about the questions I needed to ask before misunderstandings/problems emerged.RegardsMichael

The pre sales service was great, very attentive and reassuring.The contractors were polite and cleaned up when they were done. They dented my gutter, didn't fix it and didn't say anything about it.I haven't heard a thing from Mondiaux since the installation.

Sales new their product well and was able to explain it to me in a clear languageInsulation were polite,tidy and on timeCustomer service was ok but was unaware they would come and help set up app I had to contact them. The person sent spoken English was hard to understand but was very friendly and arrived on time.I know I can contact them if I need more clarification

Initially the company seemed responsive to a quick install. Installers showed on appointment day and hung the inverter.Unfortunately, due to recent renovation affecting roof installation of panels, the install has been delayed.Recent bad weather and storms has added to delays.Mondiaux communicate/customer service has been non-existant since, no emails or phone with any updates re: install.Mondiaux obviously use subcontractors to install.Yes I could pursue them via phone, but I shouldn't have to (customer service)Anyway panels sit unpacked waiting to be hung for 2 weeks now. Lucky I'm not out of pocket.

The sales/ quoting process was very straight forward and clear, outlining the inclusions and exclusions and the staging of the invoices.  There was no additional marketing or promotional words, they also promptly responded to my queries plus detail of installation dates and process, including CovidSafe protocols.The actual installation process was also very smooth, punctual and courteous, and followed all CovidSafe protocols too.  They also organised the grid connection and the monitoring device on the same day, plus a follow up visit to double check the installation a few days later.The whole process from quotation to installation was a real no fuss process with no hiccups.

Settling tech specs a fruitful discussion, Supplier was flexible, and alerted me to issues. A few delays with installation (it was the Christmas period), but again helpful and flexible, No change to price despite crossover into new subsidy period.

Knowledgeable supplier who gave several options for solar installations from cheaper to more premium.  The supplier was prepared to make a call that the meter box needed upgrading, where other suppliers would have left this till later (i.e. for battery installation). Excellent installation team. Good customer service.
Great installer. Easy process, fast, punctual.Nice to deal with. Lead you through the process and explain each step.
Always informative, provided the best system within the budget provided pro and cons.

We were very pleased with the customer service, installation and follow up from Mondiaux. We visited the showroom to look at all suitable options and prices. One or two challenges emerged with the delivery and installation because of the configuration of our place but these were easily and expertly overcome. All pricing and options were very well explained. We would highly recommend their polite and professionalapproach.Michael and Angela
Efficient quote, timely and good installation tram, very good communication throughout the whole process.
Mondiaux were good - quick turnaround to installation, quite good admin. Subcontractors were good and professional.
Super quick, super easy. Shame it wasn't lined up properly with energy retailer as I've got a solar system, but still not using it.

I contracted Mondiaux here in the ACT and they were immediately responsive providing several pricing options and good technical information. A site visit followed with a drone inspection of my roof to assess panel layout. The installation team arrived as promised 4 weeks later and were polite, skilled and tidy. The electrician’s work was professional and tidy and he even wired in my Wattwatcher device at no extra charge. System and apps working perfectly and they have arranged for my utility to install the new meter. Dealing with Mondiaux was easy and pleasant from start to finish, a very friendly, efficient and professional team.

Quote - professional and easy to work with in sorting out the final details.Installation - wet weather delayed the start and there were some scheduling delays otherwise installation was very good with some small issues that were quickly resolved.Customer service - all members of the company and installation teams were polite and easy to work with throughout the process.As quoted and promised the company organised everything from start to finish.The payment process of ten percent deposit and final payment on completion of the entire job ie installed, commissioned and connected to grid with electricity authority installation of smart meter meant that I did not pay then have to chase up getting the job fully completed.I was impressed by all the people involved with this company.

Mondiaux were very professional from start to finish with constant updates for a 10 kw system.  Nathan the salesman was informative and polite.  The installation team were very polite and efficient.They were finished installing by 3 pm. The after sales service has been excellent. Very happy with the overall process and would recommend Mondiax for your Solar needs.
Good experience dealing with the supplier. There were minor adjustments after installation  but they were handled well and promptly.

Dealing with Mondiaux was very easy, with professional and quick quotes. The team was happy to chat about different options and make suggestions. The installer was very friendly and was able to adjust the location of the inverter on the day. Very happy with the overall experience.

The sales person visited the house and looked at the roof and the old panels that were to be replaced.  He understood our desire not to spoil the aesthetics of our curved roof and the fact that we essentially wanted two systems.  The first was to replace the panels for our 3kw gross tariff (with an excellent FIT!) system and the second was to install a new 6.6 kw system.He provided  good solutions that utilised the roof space well. No hard sell.  We were kept informed during the process.  The installers were fine - friendly, neat and punctual, though we found out that they were sub-contracting - which is apparently true for most of the solar system retailers in Canberra.  That wasn't a problem.  They did a good job.
Quotes is goodInstallations was polite and tidyOn Tuesday they will organise grid connection and depend on the weather

Mondiaux provided quotes on different systems based on our requirements in a timely manner that were competitive in comparison to the other vendors I had approached. We then worked through these quotes to come to a system we were happy with.There was a supply issue with the inverter however this was overcome through an agreeable understanding.The installation was completed in within a day with good communication on the day.We did have an issue the next day with a power circuit in the house however the installer came and identified and resolved the issue in a timely manner.
Every step of the way was professional and punctual. They did help with the grid connection

Garry was very knowledgeable about the system options available to me and was able to provide assurance about my choices and reasons why.  He was quick to respond to my questions and was able to be very competitive in relation to comparable systems put forward by competitors.

Of the three Installers, Mondiaux was the only one to visit the site, which was to their advantage as they discovered the actual roof layout is somewhat deceptive using satellite shots alone. This allowed them to better adapt the panel layout and for me to have a more informative interactive conversation. This allowed them to quote for a system that would maximize the available roof space and include the panels and inverter I was after. Mondiaux provided multiple combinations in their quote of panel and inverter options. They were agnostic on the hardware and didn't push any particular brand or technology.The install went incredibly smoothly. From arrival of the installer crew, to up and running system, was just over two and a half hours. This was a 4.8Kw system.Customer service was good with regular updates on where the process was up to. They also contacted my electricity provider to kick off the grid connection, new smart meter, etc. At the time of writing this review, the smart meter is yet to be installed but they are still inside their 15 business day install period. Fingers crossed.

After some initial delays in finding an appointment time which suited me the quote provided was very comprehensive and easy to understand.  I had some further follow up questions which were answered promptly. My only criticism is that I was given very little warning about the installation date.  I was advised late Friday that the system would be installed the following Monday. The installation crew were polite and as quoted installed the system in one day and the installation went smoothly.  They were able to respond to my questions on where the inverter should be located and it was easy to make an immediate decision on where it should go. The follow up service to install and explain the App to monitor my system also went smoothly and was easy to understand. I am still waiting on my meter to be replaced but this is up to my energy retailer.  I have already been advised of the date this will occur.
Installation is yet to be done. Very professional approach taken to design and quote. Lots of excellent advice.

Very nice sales person and very knowledgeable! Very easy process, though some more communication from the supplier re installation date would have been appreciated. Fantastic installation, they even fixed up my roof.

Great company with excellent communication skills. Several issues during the installation due to complexity of install. The team addressed the issues promptly and kept me informed throughout the install. System functions perfectly well. Would highly recommend this company for solar installations in Canberra.

Mohammed contacted us straight away and organised to visit and give us a quote. He was knowledgeable, friendly and professional. He provided good advice and was available to answer questions. Installation was on time, efficient and tidy. We went with Mondiaux because they are Canberra based and we wanted to support a local company with good after care.  Overall we were very happy with the whole process.

They seemed nice enough and got the system installed as agreed in the three week period then the problems started.The system was up on the roof in the three weeks as agreed but they didn’t have it commissioned for a week after the install, they lied about it being “operational” during that time.-The job was sub contracted to another firm-they left rubbish all over my front yard, including sharp metal strapping.-the panels where installed unevenly-they cracked 3 roof tiles which the siliconed back together rather than replacing them (after insisting I provide additional tiles a couple of days prior to the install)-Their van leaked oil on my driveway and permanently stained it.-They siliconed DC label to the conduit rate than the wall or inverter.. (not an issue just seems weird)-they scratched the frames of the panels during instillation.-when I complained the workman turned up unannounced at my house and gave me a ton of attitude because I wasn’t happy.Based on these experiences I won’t use them on future jobs and am disappointed generally in the service overall.Solar power is a fantastic investment but just be sure to find a firm that will treat you and your home with some respect.

The sales and quoting process was all very professional. They were very punctual with great customer service. Everything was installed and up and running within a few weeks of placing a deposit. Highly recommended.

Dealing with Mondiaux has quite good. Their sales rep seemed honest and direct and produced a quote quickly. His service and responding to calls/messages has continued to be great even beyond the installation of the system.There were a few minor issues around system design and inverter availability however they were all resolved in a timely manner and additional costs were absorbed by the company without fuss.The installation process was great. The team showed up a few days earlier for a pre-install inspection. They then turned up on the day (on time) and installed the whole system in 5 hrs. They ensured that all rubbish from the installation was removed prior to their departure.I would highly recommend Mondiaux and already have to a number of friends.

From start to finish, Mondiaux have been polite, helpful and knowledgeable. From their sales team to the office staff, installers and after-sales people - all have been great to deal with. The grid connection after the install was all organised - we didn't have to do a thing - just sit back and enjoy the electricity savings. I would have no hesitation in recommending Mondiaux for solar.

Sales and quoting process was amazing, I had plenty of questions just to clarify things I had seen on Solar-quotes and they were up front and responded quickly and patiently throughout.Installation was good, installation date was delayed due to weather but they came out later that same week, on days that still risked rain to complete the install. There were some issues with install of Solar Analytics system but they are currently resolving those issues.

Mondiaux provided several quotes based on my request for various system sizes, brands and pricing. The team were friendly, polite and professional with the quotes and installation. The installation was not straightforward and easy as it was a double storey and glossy tiled roof. However the Mondiaux team performed the installation very efficiently and quality work. No issues whatsoever as yet and we've had rain and storms pass by since.They have always responded on my queries from the quote through to my post-installation questions.I would recommend Mondiaux with solar installation based on our experience for a reasonably large solar system for a residential property.

Started with 3 quotes through Solar Quotes. We decided to go with Mondiaux based product advice, price, and follow up service with Archie at Mondiaux.Found their service professional and at no time did I feel they were being pushy.  They answered my questions quickly and gave all the information I needed to choose the right system.It took about 6 weeks from order to installation as quoted, the installer came and did an excellent professional installation.Post installation Mondiaux have came back to guide me through on how to use the app and on how my system works.The only thing I am waiting for is the connection with my power provider to be completed which is being managed by Mondiaux.All in all very happy with the whole process.

Received 3 quotes through Solar Quotes Finn Peacock. We decided to go with Mondiaux due to their price, follow up and professionalism. Right from the start it was no nonsense professional and yet courteous.I had a large Sydney firm (who shall remain nameless suffice to say AB does the adds) who tried to discredit Mondiaux without knowing them just because they didn't have thousands of reviews. I held them to task and told them even if they proved to be a cheaper quote than Mondiaux Pty Ltd, we would not go with them because of their underhanded tactics. (They still kept calling as late as last Friday)Mondiaux visited our house, we liked that they were from Canberra. The quote they gave was very good with my Seniors discount applied. When attending for site review I was offered to upgrade to a higher wattage Risen 370 from the original quoted item Risen 330. Immediately I thought "ok I feel a price hike coming on" it turned out to be $50 cheaper. Needless to say we took that up.The installers were absolutely fabulous, knew their job and task. All who were here did the job effortlessly, spoke to me not down to me, and explained anything I asked in detail. One of the panels was damaged in transit and thy went away got the replacement and fitted it that same day. I have the utmost respect for all the guys working that day.Next day an appointment was made with me for 14:00 (2 pm) and on the dot they arrived, set-up the app with my Wi-Fi interface, gave me log-in details and all was great.I highly recommend Mondiaux Pty Ltd. I had never met them prior to this but I will sing their praises to all and sundry. Not one bad thing can I say about the entire procedure from start to stop this whole team was the most professional people I have dealt with in the Trades area here in Canberra.Thank you team Mondiaux.
Quote was provided quickly and was well priced, sales consultant (Leo) was very helpful and professional.Installation was seamless and very quick.Highly recommended.

The staff from Mondiaux were extremely helpful and informative. They provided a considerable amount of useful information in an easily understandable low-tech way. Organised all the grid connection and installation. The sales and quoting was excellent. The installation took about 4 hrs. The installers were friendly, approachable and thorough. The post-installation information was helpful with the set-up of the phone application.
